title: MZ Some recommendations on Battle Systems Plugins for my game?

posts.author: rickprado
posts.body:
EDIT: I forgot to mention!! I'm using RPG Maker MZ for my project right now, with the default battle active battle system.
Hi! Hope everyone is fine
I've asked in another post (
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...mbat-combo-system-for-mz.181555/#post-1541497
) if a plugin for a battle system like i want exists.  It turns out it might be too hard to code and there is nothing like it for MZ or other engines, specially for free (in live in Brazil, so paying in USD$ for a plugin would be quite expensive for me, at least now).
I come again to this forum to ask for suggestion on Battle System Plugins for my project. I really like JRPGs but i think the common structure of "attack/skills/defend/item" might be too tedious for players, specially the basic attack command that most of the time is left behind in the endgame, where skills do most of the damage.
So if you guys have some plugins recommendations for me to test - specially for free, since its hard to me to pay in USD$ - for my project, i would be very grateful! If if it changes or at least enhance the basic attack would be a nice addition as i've said before, i find it quite boring how basic attack are forgotten in the late game.
I'm trying to do something with custom events but they don't fight good enough.
I'm currently using the VisuStella Battle Core, so if the system is compatible with the VisuStella, would be even better for me.
Thanks for the attention!
ect.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
There is no such thing as a library of "battle systems" to try out. Sure you got your Standard turn based, which is the default. You got ATB systems floating about, which is the final fantasy thing where you wait until a character is ready to act, and there are action battle systems, although I don't think these work well in the engine.
Outside of that, no plugin will design a battle system for you in the way you're asking for. You'll have to go and design it yourself. If you don't want "attack" to be useless late game, design it in a way it's not. If you don't want a basic attack move, just get rid of it and design something else. If you don't want guard, just don't use it.
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/actor-battle-commands.125511/
Anything can be done, but there's no plug and play solution out there that just does it for you. Figure out what you want specifically, and we'll be able to help with how to make it.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
And to add to this,
I used a mixture of Plugins to get the battle system I wanted, or 90% of it.
I can't remember the plugin names I used, it was something like.
Himes to remove Attack and guard and use only Items and skills.
Yanfly's for ATB, Rows.
Then, community members helped me a lot to add some code snippets to get it how I want.
So sometimes you'll need to mix and match plugins to get the desired outcome.
